title: No agent: flag at the first gap, then wait out the cooldown
about: Without an Investigator, Egg Head raises a wrong claim from the fast check at the first gap after one turn. A second wrong claim waits until 30 s after the first flag.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The orders DB is fine, CPU is normal.
lines.why: false claim; the call gets one turn to correct it

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Okay, so let's focus on the API then.
lines.why: Decider says Priya finished: flag at half a second of silence

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Let's pull up the error logs.
lines.why: a gap, but Egg Head spoke a few seconds ago: cooldown

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.why: raised once 30 s have passed since the first flag
